AN SFX REVOLUTION
The V SFX Platinum is leading the industry as the first SFX unit to acheive 1300W, and includes top-tier features such as full compatibility with ATX 3.0 and both ITX and ATX cases, and new miniaturization technology that enhances thermal performance and increases power density.
MINI BUT MIGHTY
Flat copper wiring on the DC-DC choke, flat transformer piling, an aluminum plate dissipation structure on the full-bridge LLC, and advanced manufacturing processes enhance overall miniaturization.
ENHANCED DISSIPATION
The transformer, rectifier, full-bridge LLC, and EMI-inhibiting amorphous metal materials are fully integrated for advanced performance and heat dissipation.

FreeForm 2.0 is our blueprint for Custom. Open. Personal. hardware. Shared mounting points, open-source files, and plug-and-play modules give you full control to upgrade, tweak, and showcase your rig without starting over.

Thermal Excellence is Cooler Master’s commitment to redefining the boundaries of cooling technology through continuous innovation, research, and engineering precision. This initiative represents the culmination of decades of thermal R&D — driven by our philosophy of empowering builders.

Computex brings together the technologies shaping tomorrow’s computing landscape. 
This year, Cooler Master is opening its Taipei headquarters to showcase the cooling innovations powering the next generation of high-performance systems.

The V SFX Platinum is leading the industry as the first SFX unit to acheive 1300W, and includes top-tier features such as full compatibility with ATX 3.0 and both ITX and ATX cases, and new miniaturization technology that enhances thermal performance and increases power density.
Flat copper wiring on the DC-DC choke, flat transformer piling, an aluminum plate dissipation structure on the full-bridge LLC, and advanced manufacturing processes enhance overall miniaturization.
The transformer, rectifier, full-bridge LLC, and EMI-inhibiting amorphous metal materials are fully integrated for advanced performance and heat dissipation.
Modular cabling reduces clutter, increases airflow, and improves overall thermal performance.
Need help choosing the right power supply for your system?
Try out our comprehensive and easy-to-use PSU calculator.
OPP/ OVP/ OTP/ OCP/ SCP/ UVP/ Surge & Inrush Protection
TUV, cTUVus, CE, BSMI, FCC, CCC, EAC, UKCA
With an ATX bracket, ATX 3.0 support, and GPU compatibility with both the 40 series and previous cards, the V SFX Platinum works with both ATX and mini-ITX cases.
Includes ATX 3.0 support and a 90-degree 12+4pin (12VHPWR) PCIe 5.0 connector featuring higher electrical durability, improved safety, and capable of bringing up to 600W to your GPU.
*All performance stats confirmed in 25°C ambient temperature testing.
